items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only the existing period-aligned reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate commission cannot be assigned to sites; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage reports $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and budget records are absent or incomplete; and no incremental learning outcome is defined. Minimum measurement is one reconciled period-aligned ledger linking site/content identifiers to revenue, AI/infrastructure/domain/marketing/labor costs, and approved budget limits; cost-to-learn additionally requires a defined incremental learning outcome and attributable cost. Treat clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, SEO scores, performance scores, ordered items, and aggregate commission as non-financial or unsupported for ROI claims until reconciled. Authorize no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, requeues, monetization expansion, new production work, or unsupported revenue claims. Continue only the existing reconciliation, preserving aggregate commission as unattributed and unknowns as unknown.
